variety_description: Medium duration variety, popularly known as Maheshwari, was released by IGKVV, Raipur in 2012. Recommended for cultivation in irrigated eco-system of Chattisgarh. Suitable for rainfed bunded medium to heavy textured soils of Chattisgarh. This semi-tall variety has long slender grain, better gel consistency (59 mm) and intermediate alkali spreading value (4.6)—important benchmarks for export. Tolerant to lodging and major diseases and insect pests.
